captions: Normally, you have one wallet address. Call it Address A.
Everyone who pays you sends money to Address A.
Anyone can look up Address A and see every payment, and your balance.
With a stealth address, you share a code instead.
Three people pay you using that code.
Each payment lands at a brand-new address: B, C and D.
To everyone else, B, C and D look like three strangers.
Each payment leaves a small clue that only your key can recognise.
So your wallet finds B, C and D, and shows one balance.
And only your key can spend from them.
